# Benjamin D. Smith

> Benjamin D. Smith is an experimental atomic, optical, and quantum physicist and a National Research Council Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the Air Force Research Laboratory in Albuquerque, New Mexico. His research covers quantum sensing, laser cooling and trapping, atom interferometry, Bose-Einstein condensates, and quantum memories. He holds a Ph.D. in physics from the University of Alberta and a B.Sc. from Brigham Young University.
